_note: "Buyers are looking for X" seller-recruitment cards (source: seller-growth/WANTED-POSTS.md, numbers from the [GrowthDigest] of as_of). prep adds one every WANTED_GAP_DAYS between the listing cards, skips any post whose claim is no longer true (checked against the live listings), skips them all once as_of is older than WANTED_MAX_AGE_DAYS, and links /sell-equipment/<slug> only when that page answers 200. Refresh the numbers and as_of from the newest digest; never an exact count below 10, never views or sales. Spanish lines wait for Alan or Emmanuel to proofread.

posts.card_sub: None listed yet. List yours free.
posts.body:
Buyers looked for generators on YardSwaps about 20 times in the last month. None are listed.
If a generator is sitting in your yard between jobs or since the last storm, list it free: photo of the unit, photo of the data plate, the app fills in kW, fuel and phase. Buyers pick up at your place.
posts.question: What size is the one you have sitting?

posts.card_sub: Gooseneck, dump or utility. List it free.
posts.body:
More than 20 trailer searches on YardSwaps last month, and one trailer listed.
Gooseneck, dump, tilt or utility: if it hasn't moved since the last job, list it free. Photograph the VIN plate and the tires. Buyer hitches up at your yard.
posts.question: What's the trailer you keep meaning to sell?

posts.card_sub: Trash, transfer or a spare motor. List it free.
posts.body:
More than 10 pump searches last month on YardSwaps, zero pumps listed.
Trash pumps, transfer pumps, spare motors on a shelf: snap the tag, list it free, buyer picks up.
posts.question: Got a spare pump that hasn't run this year?

posts.card_sub: Data plate, hour meter, done. List it free.
posts.body:
Forklift searches on YardSwaps last month mostly found nothing. One is listed.
Moved to electric, or downsized the warehouse? Photograph the data plate and the hour meter, list it free, buyer comes to you.
posts.question: How many hours on yours?

posts.card_sub: Scan the tag. List it free.
posts.body:

Extra parts on a shelf, an attachment for a machine you sold, a unit you kept for parts: scan the tag and list it free.
posts.question: What's the one part you've got three of?

posts.card_sub: Retiring a truck? List it free.
posts.body:

posts.question: What's the oldest truck still in your fleet?

posts.card_sub: Paste the link. Free to list.
posts.body: Already have your equipment on Craigslist? Paste the link into YardSwaps and the photos, price and details come across. Check them, publish, done. Free.
posts.question: Where do you list equipment now?
